observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor dirt courtyard surrounded by lush green foliage and trees, near a decorated tulsi vrindavan shrine in Goa
observation.dancers: A group of women dancers in two facing lines, joined by other women standing nearby and male musicians in the background
observation.formation_and_space: Two parallel lines of women facing each other, later forming a large circle moving counterclockwise
observation.posture: Upright torso with soft knees, bending forward from the waist during bowing movements
observation.footwork: Stepping side to side, stepping in place, gentle marching on the beat with barefoot steps
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held akimbo (hands on hips) or arms linked around each other's waists, occasionally hands raised or clasped
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso bends forward from the waist during group bows; otherwise held upright with minimal hip isolation
observation.partnering: Dancers hold hands or link arms/waists in lines and circles
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level changes through bowing/bending forward; stepping turns within the circle formation
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional colorful silk sarees (nauvari style in various colors like pink, green, yellow, blue, purple) with braided hair decorated with flowers and gold jewelry
observation.cannot_infer: Low video resolution and camera angles make exact foot articulation and weight transfer details difficult to observe clearly

signature_moments.what: Dancers in two lines step toward each other and bow forward from the waist
Dancers in lines step sideways in unison, maintaining linked waists
Facing lines bow deeply toward one another in rhythm with the music
